title: 第25章 激战第26章 神识ldquo开rdquo
content_zh:
萧天愣神片刻，就立马行动起来。
确认伤口已经处理好后准备出发，继续深入。
毕竟他的目的还没达到，所需要的火种还没找到。
所以还是要继续寻找。
其实刚刚还想问一下那个少女，毕竟她修为高深，接触的东西肯定多。
不过既然错过了，就没有必要再去想了。
就在萧天打算动身的时候，身后传来了一声戏谑的声音。
“小子，跑得挺快的嘛。
害我寻找了那么多天。
要不是刚刚的听到这边有人的声音，还真不好找。”
只见一行十五个人，从萧天身后的树林中走出，而为首之人正是刚刚说话的那个。
只见他身材魁梧，面相凶恶。
手中已经握住了一柄大刀。
那柄大刀周身泛着血色红光，煞气逼人，一看就知道不是凡品！
他身后之人也是手握兵器，并且慢慢的向萧天合围而来。
一副胜券在握的样子。
萧天扫了一眼也是惊讶不已。
眼前的这些人个个修为不俗，最低的也是萧天五层天后期修为，而为首之人更是达到了先天九层天巅峰修为，已经是一只脚迈入结丹期的存在。
“看来你们为了对付我也是不遗余力呀！”
萧天笑道。

“你说的没错，怪就怪你太过妖孽了，已经严重威胁到我李家发展。
所以只能是先除掉你了。”
那个壮汉说道
闻言萧天却是嗤之以鼻，说道“想杀我是真，威胁到李家的发展却是更像是借口吧。
在你们认知中，我的修为断然威胁不了你们的发展，更不可能派出如此多的高手来追杀我。
所以我猜你们李家现在做主的应该已经不是姓李了吧！”
李家众人脸上也是一惊，没想到这萧天的智慧也是如此妖孽。
仅仅凭着这只言片语，就推断出了事情的一个大概！
也确实如同萧天所猜测的那样，现在李家并不是李家家主说了算，而是一位来自帝国之人。
至于为什么一定要拿住萧天，他们也不知道。
那个大人物也没有说，他们也没敢问。
content_en:
Xiao Tian was stunned for a moment and then took action immediately.
After confirming that the wound has been treated, prepare to go and continue deeper.
After all, his goal has not been achieved, and the fire he needs has not yet been found.
So we still have to keep looking.
In fact, I wanted to ask that girl just now. After all, she has a high level of cultivation and must have been exposed to many things.
But since you missed it, there is no need to think about it again.
Just when Xiao Tian was about to leave, a joking voice came from behind.
"Boy, you run pretty fast.
I searched for it for so many days.
If I hadn't heard someone's voice here just now, it would have been really hard to find him. "
A group of fifteen people was seen walking out of the woods behind Xiao Tian, and the leader was the one who had just spoken.
I saw that he was tall and tall, with a ferocious face.
He already held a large knife in his hand.
The whole body of that big sword was glowing with blood-red light, and the evil aura was overwhelming. You could tell at a glance that it was not an ordinary thing!
The people behind him also held weapons and slowly surrounded Xiao Tian.
He looked like he had a winning chance.
Xiao Tian glanced at it and was surprised.
The people in front of them all have good cultivation levels. The lowest one is Xiao Tian, ​​who is in the late stage of the fifth level of heaven. The leader has reached the peak level of the ninth level of innate heaven, and has already entered the elixir formation stage with one foot.
"It seems that you are sparing no effort to deal with me!"
Xiao Tian smiled.
"You're right, it's because you are too evil and have seriously threatened the development of my Li family.
So I can only get rid of you first. "
The strong man said
Hearing this, Xiao Tian sneered and said, "It's true that you want to kill me, but threatening the development of the Li family is more of an excuse.
In your understanding, my cultivation is definitely not a threat to your development, let alone sending so many masters to hunt me down.
So I guess the one who calls the shots in your Li family is no longer named Li! "
Everyone in the Li family was also shocked. They didn't expect that Xiao Tian's wisdom was so evil.
Just from this few words, I can infer a general idea of ​​the matter!
It is indeed as Xiao Tian guessed that the head of the Li family has the final say now, not the head of the Li family, but a person from the empire.
As for why Xiao Tian must be captured, they don't know.
The big shot didn't say anything, and they didn't dare to ask.
